_doc: The public pages of one subject, built from one lite-N by cad/viewer/pages.py (vt350#220). Top level: what to export, the render look (owner 2026-11-17: AgX Punchy, plastic 0.2, -1.4 EV; the key light turns and tilts with each camera), where pages go ('release' takes {model}). 'turntable': cameras and page text. 'viewer' (optional): the live 3D page, its GLB and its compare render.

turntable.blurb: 252 Blender Cycles renders of the left toolhead on the MadMax carriage: drag round it at 36 angles and seven heights, from 40° below to 40° above, with the light turning with the camera.

page.title: VT350 · Left head on the
page.foot: Real Blender Cycles renders (render.py, the render colour map, AgX Punchy, −1.4 EV), one every 10° round the toolhead at seven heights, from 40° below to 40° above. The light turns with the camera, so every side is lit the same. Drag sideways to turn it, up or down to change the height; arrow keys work too. Only these angles exist: for any angle, use the live 3D viewer.
page.credits: Parts: A4Tv2 and Orbiter (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, DW-Tas / Orbiter Projects), MadMax carriage, plate and clips (GPL-3.0, zruncho3d, andrewmcgr), Beacon RevH (MIT, Beacon3D), O2S and Smart Sensor (CC0-1.0, Lorincz Electronics); blowers modelled from measurements. Each part keeps its licence; non-commercial use only.

viewer.blurb: The same toolhead as a live 3D model you can turn, pan and zoom, beside a Cycles render of it and a button that puts the live view at the render's camera.

page.title: VT350 · Left head on the
page.compare_alt: Cycles render of the same toolhead and carriage, seen from the front right and above
page.caption: Blender Cycles, the same export and colour map, AgX Punchy look and less shiny plastic at −1.4 EV, 35 mm lens from the front right and above. It's a still picture: the live view on the left is the one you can turn.
page.about: A4Tv2 toolhead with Orbiter 2.5, Smart Sensor and Orbitool O2S, on the MadMax plate and the gantry carriage with its Beacon (vt350#220). Colours are the render colour map's.
